program:
PARAMS = {
    "gbw":    (15e6, 11e6, 25e6),
    "I1":     (60e-6, 30e-6, 90e-6),
    "gmid1":  (20, 14, 25),
    "L1":     (5.0, 2.0, 8.0),
    "gmid3":  (9, 6, 12),
    "L3":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "I7":     (240e-6, 120e-6, 300e-6),
    "gmidn":  (13, 9, 16),
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "kz":     (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]; Itail = 2*I1; I7 = p["I7"]

    # PMOS mirror load: moderate gm/Id -> Vsg ~1.1 V so d1 ~0.7 V, M1 saturated
    m3p = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3p.vgs)
    m4 = m3
    vd1 = 1.8 - abs(m3p.vgs)
    # input pair: long L, weak/moderate inversion, big area for 1/f noise
    m1p = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.4, vsb=0.25)
    vtail = 0.9 - m1p.vgs
    vds1 = max(vd1 - vtail, 0.2)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vds1, vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    # second stage PMOS CS, same density/L as M3 (low systematic offset)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors: SAME gm/Id and L everywhere -> accurate ratios
    mbp = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mbp.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=max(vtail, 0.2))
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    Cc = gm1/(2*PI*p["gbw"])
    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["kz"]*(1 + cl/Cc)/gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = gm1/(m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm7/(m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1*A2) - 3.0   # empirical derate
    ugbw = gm1/(2*PI*Cc)
    wu = 2*PI*ugbw
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7/(cl*(1 + C1/Cc) + C1)
    p3 = m3.gm/(2*m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    pm = 90 - 0.6*math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p3))
    kT4 = 4*1.380649e-23*300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2*kT4*0.8/gm1*(1 + m3.gm/gm1))
    # flicker ~ 1/sqrt(W*L) of input pair; W*L ~ I*L^2*(gmid)^2 crude scaling,
    # calibrated against iter0 (341 nV @ L=1.5, gm/Id=15, I1=17.8uA)
    ref_area = 17.8e-6*1.5*1.5
    area = I1*p["L1"]*p["L1"]*(p["gmid1"]/15.0)**2
    vn_f = 3.4e-7*math.sqrt(ref_area/area)
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(vn_th**2 + vn_f**2)
    power = 1.8*(iref + Itail + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "power": power, "noise_1k": noise_1k}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS out, Rz-Cc)
